g.text: Data model: PostgreSQL (system of record + outbox) and MongoDB (audit + history)
trade_id : varchar(64) (null if blank on input)
traceparent : varchar(55) (trace that wrote the row, ADR-012)
outcome : ACCEPTED | REPLACED | REJECTED | EXPIRED | POISON | FAILED
Rows live only until relayed, then are deleted (ADR-005).
Append-only: no update or delete paths (A-45).
